extensionDescription.message: AI chat side panel: talk with your team's AI agent and share the page you're on only when you approve.

storeDesc.message:
TeamClu opens a chat side panel next to any web page, where you talk with your teammates and your team's AI agent.

What it does:
• Side panel chat — chat with your team's AI agent and teammates without leaving the current tab.
• Ask about the page — when an agent needs the page you are on, the side panel asks first. Nothing is read until you click Allow, and you can turn this off entirely in Settings.
• Link button (optional) — on sites you add in Settings, hover a link and click the TeamClu button to send that link to the agent.
• Team sessions — shared conversations with live sync.

Requirements:
• A TeamClu account (email + password, email code, or Google sign-in).
• Agents are provided by your team (a computer running the TeamClu agent connected to your team).

Privacy: no site access is granted at install, there is no background page reading and no browsing-history collection. Error reports are off unless you turn them on. Full policy: https://www.teamclu.ai/privacy-extension
